description: This file defines a Java class LogWrapper that implements the LogNode interface. It wraps Android's native Log utility to facilitate logging, and supports chaining to other LogNode instances for extended logging functionality.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface and supporting chained logging nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to which logs will be passed.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message with the specified priority and tag, optionally including a Throwable, and forwards the log to the next node if present.
